# Backend Contract Checklist: Backend Development Contract Compliance

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of the requirements for
the backend contract, with emphasis on the pipeline/admin-console boundary and the
serializer-first API rules.
**Created**: 2026-11-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review
artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality
criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for
requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the pipeline application's owned models enumerated exhaustively, including site, link, capture, trace, table, classification, plan, replay, alert, and cost-ledger models? [Completeness, Spec §FR-048]
- [x] CHK002 Are the pipeline application's owned services, tasks, clients, helpers, and constants enumerated exhaustively? [Completeness, Spec §FR-049]
- [x] CHK003 Are the admin console's retained responsibilities explicitly bounded to the operator approval and console surface? [Completeness, Spec §FR-050]
- [x] CHK004 Are notification-removal requirements defined for settings, URL routing, services, tests, and documentation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-052]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the response envelope on error responses, not only success responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for nested and computed payloads that are not direct model instances? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Are audit requirements defined for bulk create, update, and delete operations? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements defined for updating the frontend client when the response envelope changes? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK009 Is the health-check response contract specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK010 Is the deprecation policy for an old API version specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK011 Is the pipeline application's "declared interface" defined in terms of what it exposes and what the admin console may call? [Clarity, Spec §FR-050]
- [x] CHK012 Is it explicit whether the admin console may import pipeline models directly, or only through the interface? [Clarity, Spec §FR-051]
- [x] CHK013 Is "pipeline helper" defined precisely enough to decide whether a module belongs in the pipeline application? [Clarity, Spec §FR-049]
- [x] CHK014 Is "default page size" quantified with a concrete number or a named setting? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK015 Is the response envelope's `page` object shape defined with its fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK016 Is the validation error shape defined with its field names and status codes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK017 Is the ownership of configuration constants between the pipeline and admin console specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-049]
- [x] CHK018 Is the meaning of "operator-facing approval and console surface" defined with concrete endpoints or capabilities? [Clarity, Spec §FR-050]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK019 Do the authorization requirements align between the default permission rule and the constitution's django-guardian requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK020 Do the soft-delete requirements align between the shared base model, the manager behavior, and the physical-delete operation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024–FR-026]
- [x] CHK021 Do the task requirements align between the owning application, the task module, and the configured backend? [Consistency, Spec §FR-034–FR-036]
- [x] CHK022 Do the migration requirements align between the data model, the quickstart, and the enforcement gates? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK023 Is the Pydantic conflict between the constitution and the contract resolved in one place and traceable from the spec? [Conflict, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Do the pipeline boundary requirements align with the project structure in the plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-048–FR-051, Plan §Project Structure]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK025 Can the pipeline separation be objectively verified without inspecting implementation internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [x] CHK026 Can "zero notification references" be objectively verified across the repository? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012]
- [x] CHK027 Are the acceptance scenarios for the pipeline boundary independent of the API envelope changes? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 6]
- [x] CHK028 Are the success criteria for serializer-produced responses measurable per endpoint? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK029 Is there a traceability mapping from each functional requirement to at least one success criterion? [Traceability, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for a pipeline task that fails after the admin console has already returned a response? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for an operator console request that reaches a pipeline service while the task backend is unavailable? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for a pipeline model that is referenced by an existing admin-console migration during the move? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK033 Are requirements defined for a public endpoint that must remain anonymous after the default permission changes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for a soft-deleted record that is referenced by another model? [Coverage, Spec §FR-025]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK035 Is the behavior defined when a pipeline model is accidentally left in the admin console application? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK036 Is the behavior defined when the admin console imports a pipeline model directly instead of using the interface? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK037 Is the behavior defined when a notification reference remains in settings, URLs, services, or tests? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK038 Is the behavior defined when a migration move changes the application label but not the table name? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK039 Is the behavior defined when a serializer response contains a null or empty collection? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013]

- [x] CHK043 Are requirements defined for the production image after the pipeline application is added? [Gap, Spec §FR-045]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.

### Clarification log (2026-11-05)

The following gaps were resolved by updating `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `research.md`,
`data-model.md`, `contracts/api-conventions.md`, and `quickstart.md`:

- Error envelope, health response, page shape, default page size, deprecation policy,
  bulk audit, frontend envelope update, pipeline constants ownership, operator surface
  scope, operator latency, and structured pipeline logging are now explicit.
- The pipeline/admin-console boundary now names the owned models, services, tasks,
  clients, helpers, and constants, and forbids direct pipeline model imports from the
  admin console.
- The migration edge case for an app-label move and the null/empty collection case are
  now documented.
- The test-framework migration scope is now limited to `backend/src/apps/*/tests/` and
  `backend/src/apps/*/tests.py`; the frontend keeps Vitest.

The final four items were resolved by adding FR-063 through FR-066:

- CHK030: a task that fails after acceptance parks the link in `dead_lettered`, raises
  an alert, and is reflected on the next console read.
- CHK031: an unavailable task backend returns `503 task_backend_unavailable` and leaves
  the record unchanged.
- CHK034: a soft delete of a referenced record is refused with a conflict; optional
  references are cleared first.
- CHK042: the pipeline interface is internal, requires an authenticated operator, and
  enforces the same permission checks as the console.
